name: Exam Screen-Side Monitor (Prototype)
description: Research prototype: captures browser cheating-detection signals, the URL/title of the tab a student switches to, a tab screenshot, periodic webcam frames, and the list of other extensions installed and enabled in the browser. Sends events to a local proctor server, which forwards screenshots/webcam frames to remote analysis services (VLM / computer-vision review score) over the network — not local-only.
